claimCard.canonicalDebunk: The European Commission operates within the competences conferred upon it by the Member States through the Treaties, as outlined in Article 5 of the Treaty on European Union. Any changes to this allocation of competences require treaty amendments agreed upon and ratified by all Member States. The President of the European Commission does not possess the authority to unilaterally alter this division of powers. This claim misrepresents the legal framework governing the EU's institutional structure.
